name: Avoriaz
description: Avoriaz is unique in Europe — a completely car-free pedestrian resort at 1,800m. Access is by cable car from Les Prodains or by road (cars park at the entrance). Streets are snow-covered, transport is by horse-drawn sleigh or on skis. Ski-in/ski-out from every accommodation — even the bakery is accessible on skis. The architecture is striking 1960s modernism, designed by Jean-Marcel Aubert. Central to the 600km Portes du Soleil domain with direct access to Switzerland. Famous for the Avoriaz Fantastic Film Festival and the Stash snowpark.

overview.atmosphere: Car-free, snow-sure, purpose-built resort at 1,800m. Europe's only fully pedestrian resort — horse-drawn sleighs for transport. Central to the Portes du Soleil 600km domain.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Paragliding, dog sledding, snowshoeing, cinema, events (Fantastic Film Festival)

villages.name: Avoriaz
villages.character: Car-free pedestrian resort, horse-drawn sleighs, striking modernist architecture, snow-covered streets, ski-in/ski-out throughout

honest_drawbacks: Unique architecture divides opinion — loved or hated
Car-free means parking at entrance and using sleigh transport
Can feel quiet compared to Morzine
Limited non-ski activities for non-skiers without car access
